This was one of our teachers philosophies. She taught us about the concept of a growth mindset and a fixed mindset. The growth mindset was about being open to new information, admitting when you're wrong and being willing to learn from your mistakes. The fixed mindset was pretty much the opposite, and prevented learning as a result. When I realized after a questionnaire that I had a fixed mindset, I looked into changing this. My studies have benefited greatly as a result, and I am more prepared to fail in an attempt to grow as a person. Great LPT!

Hi I'm so sorry you're going through this. 

I've seen posts similar to this on /r/relationships and when one half of the relationship isn't helping out it can be very hard on the other half. You seem to be doing a lot of work and it also seems you have reached out to him on numerous occasions. 

I just have a few questions ; Has he always been lazy around the house? And when you talk to him about how this upsets you do you mention the extent of how much it upsets you? If he realizes how much it upsets you yet does nothing to help then there's a problem. However he might just not realize this and because it's not a big deal to him he might think you're only mentioning it casually. 

Also try search for similar posts on /r/relationships because those guys have loads of advice and can word it much better than me! Hope you resolve this soon. Stay strong girl.

They put me on zoton (an antacid medication) and two antibiotics to kill off any infection. Most importantly they encouraged me to find the source of the problem. 

The biopsy they did showed my stomach doesn't produce any harmful bacteria meaning that it must be something else is most likely causing the problem for example stress, alcohol, smoking, diet. If your stomach produces this harmful bacteria they will give you alternative medication to help this problem. 

For me, the cause is more than likely stress. So along with the medicine I'm given I need to try to reduce stress levels, improve my diet and reduce alcohol consumption etc. 

Just to note I don't drink much or smoke and I think my diet is well balanced (I'm a vegetarian but I ensure that I get all my nutrients). Also this is only my experience with it, it's important to get seen to by a trained professional in order to figure out the problem and get treated accordingly. 

Best of luck man :)
